STAR HEALTH AND ALLIED INSURANCE CO. LTD.
Claims Department, Chennai

Letter Ref: STAR/CLM/2024/889
Dated: 14th June 2024

To,
Shri Ramesh Iyer
12, Gandhi Road, Coimbatore

Sub: Repudiation of claim no. CLM-2024-70215 under Star Comprehensive

Dear Sir,
We have received your claim for reimbursement of Rs. 3,40,500/- towards Laparoscopic Cholecystectomy undergone at PSG Hospitals, Coimbatore from 22/05/2024.
On scrutiny, the claim is not admissible under Clause 2 (Specified disease / procedure waiting period) since the policy commenced on 01/04/2023 and the 24-month waiting period for gall bladder surgery is not complete.
If you are not satisfied, you may approach our Grievance Redressal Officer within 15 days of this letter.

ICICI LOMBARD GENERAL INSURANCE COMPANY LIMITED

Date: 03-02-2025
Claim Number: CLM-2025-11872
Policy Number: 4128/HAE/2024/00911
Product: Health AdvantEdge
Patient Name: Mrs. Sunita Rao
Date of Admission: 18-01-2025
Hospital Name: Care Hospitals, Banjara Hills
Treatment: Septoplasty
Amount Claimed: INR 98,450

Reason for Repudiation: Clause 4 - The admission was for a planned procedure that could be done as day care, and inpatient stay was not medically necessary.

You may represent against this decision within 30 days.

Care Health Insurance Limited

7 October 2024

Dear Mr. Faisal Khan,

Re: Claim CLM-2024-33410, policy Care Supreme

Thank you for submitting your claim of ₹1,12,000 for treatment of dengue fever at Max Hospital, Patparganj, where you were admitted on 19 September 2024.
We are unable to settle the claim as the original discharge summary and the platelet count reports requested on 25 September 2024 have not been received despite two reminders.
The claim will be reconsidered once these documents are submitted.

HDFC ERGO GENERAL INSURANCE COMPANY LTD.
Claim Settlement Letter
Date: 2025-08-29
Claim No.: CLM-2025-48821
Insured Name: Deepa Menon
Policy: Optima Restore
Hospital: Aster Medcity, Kochi
Date of Admission: 2025-08-10
Billed Amount: Rs. 2,15,600

Your claim has been partly settled. The insured stayed in a suite room at Rs 12,000 per day while the eligible room rent is Rs 6,000 per day, so associated charges were reduced proportionately as per Section 3.1. Non-medical items worth Rs 8,300 were also deducted.

ICICI Lombard
Dated 11/11/2024

Claim Reference: CLM-2024-90117
Dear Mr. Harish Patel,
This is with regard to your claim for Rs. 61,250 under Arogya Sanjeevani for hospitalisation at Sterling Hospital, Vadodara on 02/10/2024.
The hospitalisation was intimated to us on 28/10/2024, 26 days after admission, and the documents were submitted after the time allowed by the policy. No reason for the delay was given, so the claim is rejected.
You may write to the Insurance Ombudsman, Ahmedabad if you disagree.

Star Health
Date: 21.03.2025
Claim No: CLM-2025-20990
Patient: Kavya Reddy
Plan: Family Health Optima

Dear Madam,
The claim for Rs. 45,000 for root canal treatment and extraction at Apollo Dental, Hyderabad on 05.03.2025 is not payable. Dental treatment is excluded under Code Excl 08 unless it requires hospitalisation due to an accident.

HDFC ERGO
16 January 2025

Dear Ms. Anjali Verma,

We refer to claim CLM-2025-00342 for Rs. 1,75,000 for appendicectomy at Fortis Hospital, Noida, admitted on 02 January 2025, under my:Optima Secure.
Our records show that the policy lapsed on 15 November 2024 and the renewal premium was received only on 05 January 2025, after the grace period. There was no cover in force on the date of admission, and the claim is therefore declined.

CARE HEALTH INSURANCE LTD
Repudiation Letter

Date: 09/07/2025
Claim ID: CLM-2025-61204
Name of Insured: Mr. Joseph Mathew
Policy: Care
DOA: 21/06/2025
Name of Hospital: Lisie Hospital, Ernakulam
Procedure: Total Knee Replacement
Claimed Amount: Rs 3,95,000
Diagnosis code: M17.11

The insured has been a known case of osteoarthritis of both knees since 2021, before the policy inception on 10/02/2023. This pre-existing disease is covered only after 36 months of continuous coverage. Claim repudiated under Clause 4.1.
